purpose: Extend the canonical Glob inquiry routing vocabulary so useful sources can be retained across all materially relevant Worldshepherd domains without rewriting historical registry records.

routes.ATOMIC_AND_MOLECULAR_MODELS: atomic/molecular structure, line-list, collisional-radiative and molecular-model validation
routes.PLASMA_AND_FUSION_DATA: fusion/plasma diagnostics, transport, atomic data and archived discharge/diagnostic corpora
routes.ADAPTIVE_METASURFACE_CONTROL: programmable electromagnetic boundary-condition, metasurface and field-control methods
routes.MATERIALS_AND_MANUFACTURING: synthesis, additive/subtractive processing, assembly, scale-up and fabrication methods
routes.IP_AND_COMMERCIALIZATION: patent, licensing, standards-to-market, capital, productization and commercialization intelligence
routes.RF_HARDWARE: RF/microwave/THz components, high-power transmission, couplers, antennas and measurement hardware
routes.CHEMISTRY_AND_CHEMICAL_DATA: chemical identities, reactions, analytical chemistry and structured chemical-data resources
routes.SENSING_AND_SENSOR_FUSION: sensor architectures, raw/derived observation pipelines, fusion, nuisance rejection and alarm logic
routes.SOFTWARE_AND_DATA_ENGINEERING: APIs, schemas, interoperability, data pipelines, parsers, storage, transformation and software architecture
routes.AI_ML_AND_MODEL_VALIDATION: machine-learning, surrogate/model evaluation, statistical learning, benchmarking and model/data reconciliation
routes.SYSTEMS_ENGINEERING_AND_GOVERNANCE: requirements, standards, lifecycle controls, audit/governance, decision gates and architecture practices
routes.OPERATIONS_AND_RELIABILITY: maintenance, scheduling, incident/failure handling, availability, RUL, recovery and operational optimization
routes.SIMULATION_AND_NUMERICAL_METHODS: solvers, numerical algorithms, model reduction, uncertainty, multiphysics and computational validation
routes.TEST_AND_MEASUREMENT: metrology, calibration, instrumentation, interlaboratory comparison, measurement uncertainty and NDE
routes.SUPPLY_CHAIN_AND_PRODUCTION: critical materials, sourcing, production constraints, process scale-up, logistics and manufacturing readiness
routes.ENVIRONMENTAL_AND_CIVIL_SYSTEMS: civil infrastructure, environmental monitoring/remediation, geotechnical, waste and built-environment systems

claims_boundary: Routing expresses utility only. It does not modify or imply Glob P2/P1/G1/M1/N0 evidence status.
